notes.title: Yuga Aoyama joins the fight today! ✨
notes.content:
[h2]The dazzling student of Class 1-A is here to win the fight, but can his stomach take the hit? His trusty belt channels his powerful quirk Navel Laser into a blade or a ray capable of sending his opponents flying. Watch out for the landing![/h2]

Yuga Aoyama is the fifth and last DLC character of the Season Pass 2 of MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2. This concludes the second season pass of the game. Each DLC character is available as part of the Season Pass or can be purchased separately.

A demo is also available on PC, giving you access to the beginning of the game in “Story Mode” and to “Free Battle” with six characters from the roster.

notes.title: Midnight joins the fight today!
notes.content:
[h2]Don’t let her looks fool you, pro hero Midnight will put you to sleep!
[/h2]

You can now whip your way through the arena as the most alluring teacher of U.A. High School. Use her favourite weapon and Quirk “Somnambulist” to spread an irresistible scent sure to put her opponents down on their knees! 

Midnight is the fourth DLC character of the Season Pass 2 of [b]MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2[/b]. Only one character left this season! Each DLC character is available as part of the Season Pass or can be purchased separately.

notes.title: Kurogiri joins the fight today! 🌫️
notes.content:
[h2]A strange fog falls onto the battle arena… It’s Kurogiri![/h2]

The mysterious asset of the League of Villain joins the fight today. Use his Quirk “Warp Gate” to take your opponent by surprise by appearing out of nowhere and trap them with your dark portals.

Kurogiri is the third DLC character of the Season Pass 2 of [b]MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2[/b]. Each DLC character is available as part of the Season Pass 2 or can be purchased separately.

notes.title: Present Mic joins the fight today! 🎤
notes.content:
[h2]🎤🔊🔊
ARE YOU READY LISTENERS??!
IT'S SUPER RADIO TIME![/h2]

Pro Hero Present Mic is here to teach you some manners!

Starting today you can fight as the eccentric teacher and famous commentator of the U.A. Sport Festival. His Quirk modulates the volume of his voice, allowing him to create devastating sonic shockwaves strong enough to render his opponent powerless and blowback anything in his path.

Present Mic is the second DLC character of the Season Pass 2 of MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2. Each DLC character is available as part of the Season Pass or can be purchased separately.

[i]The demo is still available on PC, giving you access to the beginning of the game in “Story Mode” and to “Free Battle” with six characters from the roster.[/i]

notes.title: Shinso Hitoshi joins the fight today!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Shinso Hitoshi[/b] will make his debut today in [b]MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2[/b] as a new DLC character. [/h2]

Shinso Hitoshi’s Quirk allows him to put someone in a state where they are forced to obey [b]whatever he commands[/b].
[previewyoutube=fO-LaCNXcTw;full][/previewyoutube]

Moreover, to celebrate the release of the [b]3rd My Hero Academia Movie[/b], World Heroes' Mission, we will be offering the [b]“Three Musketeers set”[/b], a unique costume set for [b]Midoriya[/b], [b]Bakugo[/b] and [b]Todoroki[/b].

Finally, if you didn’t join the fight yet, don’t hesitate further. [b]A demo is available for free from today[/b], giving access to the beginning of the game in “Story Mode” and to “Free Battle” with six characters from the roster.

notes.title: Fight as Gentle & La Brava from today in MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2!
notes.content:
[h2]The iconic duo [b]Gentle & La Brava[/b] is making their grand debut today in[b] MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2[/b].[/h2]

Gentle commits the crimes and La Brava films those, the notorious partners will be playable as one character!

A new costume pack is also available for purchase : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587400/MY_HERO_ONES_JUSTICE_2_Celebration_Wear_Set/]The Celebration Wear Set[/url].

We are also happy to share the news that a new Season Pass will be coming soon! Stay tuned as we will release more information about the Season Pass 2 content later this summer.

[b]Gentle & La Brava[/b] are the fifth DLC character of [b]MY HERO ONE’S JUSTICE 2[/b]. Each DLC character is available as part of the Season Pass or can be purchased separately.
